name: Silver Waterfall
summary: Waterfall about 12 km toward the pass: walk to the bridge under the fall for the drop below O Quy Ho. The fall is about 200 m, and the water is loudest at the base. A stair reaches an arch bridge at about 30 m, with a view back toward town and the Sín Chải valley. Winter ice here is among the thickest in Sa Pa. An adult is 20,000 đồng and a child is 10,000 đồng. Read the booth.
getThere: About 12 km toward O Quy Ho.
heroCaption: Silver Waterfall and the bridge at the base

notice.title: This fall is about 200 m
notice.body: Love Waterfall, farther along Highway 4D, is 34 m. Silver Waterfall is about 200 m.

body: Silver Waterfall, Thác Bạc, is about 12 km from town, under O Quy Ho, at the head of the Muong Hoa stream. Walk to the base, where the water is loudest. A stair reaches an arch bridge at about 30 m. From there the view goes back toward town and the Sín Chải valley. Winter ice here is among the thickest in Sa Pa.
An adult is 20,000 đồng and a child is 10,000 đồng. Read the booth. The Muong Hoa stream below is the lower section of this fall.

figures.caption: The fall, the bridge, and the water at the base
figures.alt: Silver Waterfall dropping past a footbridge into a rocky stream

gettingThere: The fall is about 12 km from town on the way to O Quy Ho pass, on National Highway 4D toward Lai Chau. Love Waterfall is farther along the same road, about 14 km from town and about 3 km from the crest.

legs.heading: From the stone church
legs.body: Ride about 12 km toward O Quy Ho. The fall is under the pass.

admissionNote: 20,000 đồng for an adult and 10,000 đồng for a child. Read the booth.
